title: Synergistic removal mechanism of tetracycline by ethylenediamine modified magnetic chitosan based Fenton-like catalyst
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36507-36516
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04059G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuankun Liu, Xiaotian Guo, Liyuan Zhao, Wenqi Duan, Yeqian Huang, Xiaojuan Wang
Magnetic chitosan nanoparticles (EMMCS-G) were successfully prepared and modified with glutaraldehyde and ethylenediamine. These nanoparticles serve as an effective Fenton catalyst for the efficient removal of tetracycline.
